functions.name: corroborate_references_locally
functions.description: 2026-09-07, added, metadata-only (no graph edge -- needs seq_matrix/reference_df, which only exist after the DECIPHER alignment step (refs_to_matrix.R), later in the pipeline than seq_to_match.R's own scope; wire in directly following the real production workflows' pattern if you're past that point). Free, zero-NCBI-call reference corroboration from a workflow's own already-built seq_matrix: flags an accession 'corroborated' when an INDEPENDENT (different submission batch) conspecific deposit agrees at >= min_pident over >= min_overlap of the amplicon.
